environment.host: Intel Mac (x86_64); load average about 4 to 20 during the runs
environment.note: Host timings only. Before and after ran alternately on the same machine, twice each; the second pair is shown. Device frame timings (UI-thread motion time per frame and dropped frames on the drag-under-load screen) weren't recorded.

host_runtime.command: python scripts/benchmark-runtime.py --imports 3 (before: main at cb31e64 with its own core build, via PYTHONPATH)
host_runtime.note: import_ms is lower because Motion loads lazily and the eager Animated module is gone. motion_frame_200_styles_us is one display frame of the core's motion runtime driving 200 animated styles from a running spring: about 8 microseconds per style, including the worklet run, style diffing, and encoding the host writes.
